tooltip.microdrone.battery_desc: Hold and Right-Click drone to attach / Sneak Right-Click to detach (Fast recharge on Charging Station)

tooltip.microdrone.esc_board_desc: Electronic speed controller board regulating 4 brushless motors.
tooltip.microdrone.drone_screws_desc: High-strength miniature screws securing motors and frame.
tooltip.microdrone.connection_cable_desc: Heat-resistant silicone wiring harness connecting battery and ESC.
tooltip.microdrone.radio_antenna_desc: High-gain omnidirectional antenna enabling long-range link.
tooltip.microdrone.gimbal_stick_desc: Dual-axis joystick stick mechanism for precise throttle and steering.

tooltip.microdrone.tiny_spring_desc: Precision tension spring returning joysticks to center position.
tooltip.microdrone.lcd_screen_desc: Sharp display module rendering real-time telemetry and battery status.

tooltip.microdrone.motor_shaft_desc: Tempered hardened steel shaft resisting high rotational torque.
